scope_note: Pretrained COCO detector used as is. No AERIS training, tuning or measured AERIS accuracy. Thresholds are the upstream COCO evaluation defaults, not validation-selected.

weights.license: Apache-2.0: published as release assets of the Apache-2.0 repository, which states no separate weight terms
weights.training_data: COCO train2017 per upstream; COCO images carry per-image Flickr licences and the annotations CC BY 4.0

upstream_onnx_cross_check.role: independent cross-check of the AERIS export only; the deliverable is the model AERIS exports itself

tensor.name: images
tensor.value_range: 0 to 255, no mean/std normalisation (upstream non-legacy ValTransform)

input.inverse: x_original = x_input * width / resized_width, y_original = y_input * height / resized_height (edge coordinates), then clip to [0, width] x [0, height]

output.name: output
output.channels: 0-1 grid offsets, 2-3 log size, 4 objectness probability, 5-84 class probabilities (COCO 80 contiguous classes)
output.anchor_order: stride 8, 16, 32; row-major within each level (index = y * grid_width + x)
output.decode: cx = (dx + x) * stride, cy = (dy + y) * stride, w = exp(lw) * stride, h = exp(lh) * stride, in padded-input pixels

postprocess.class_selection: argmax over the 80 classes, as upstream yolox.utils.postprocess

nms.rule: suppress a lower-scored box whose IoU with a kept box is > threshold
nms.order: score descending, ties by anchor index

postprocess.source: yolox/exp/yolox_base.py test_conf 0.01 and nmsthre 0.65 (upstream COCO evaluation settings)

availability_reason.max_detections_per_frame: upstream applies no per-frame cap; evaluators apply their own top-k budget

class_mapping.unmapped: every other COCO class is dropped, including bird (index 14) and kite (index 33)

export.silu: replaced by x * sigmoid(x) before export, as upstream tools/export_onnx.py

parity_tolerances.boundary_exemption: a detection present in only one output passes only when its score is within 0.001 of the score threshold or its IoU with a box kept by the other output is within 0.001 of the NMS threshold; every other unmatched detection fails

items.item: YOLOX source at the pinned commit
